params.title: Attendance
params.description: Clock records per employee per working day, with the Working Hours Act compliance checks on rest time, maximum shift length and breaks.

params.title: Attendance
params.note: time-attendance-mvp (2026-07-13): raw per-day clock record (klokregistratie) -- AttendanceRecord is raw clock data, Timesheet stays the per-period approved-hours record (design D5, no automation between them). The 'Attendance' data widget excludes employeeId since Related already resolves and links the Employee by name. lifecycleActions expose exactly sluiten/heropenen (open<->gesloten, design D4) -- no invented approval edges (approval lives on Timesheet, not here). No files widget -- the schema carries no document/retention field (the EmploymentContractDetail no-fabricated-leaves reasoning). No stat KPI -- a single day's hours is not a headline aggregate (the LeaveRequestDetail precedent). No comms/calendar leaves. Audit history is a sidebar tab.
